issue_binding: SzeChunYiu/ORION-paper#49 A3 baselines: current candidate responsibility/closure-aware policy
purpose: Freeze the exact executable identity of the A3 candidate policy before any protected prediction, baseline selection or gold reveal. Closes the missing CANDIDATE arm of EXECUTION_AND_ANALYSIS_FREEZE_V1.json baseline_identities.

candidate_policy_identity.decision_rule: any CONTRADICTED premise -> REOPEN; else any UNKNOWN premise -> CANNOT_CHECK; else REUSE
candidate_policy_identity.premise_universe: every normalized member-manifest entry of the BEFORE RO-Crate of the frozen version pair (certificate issuance state); members present only in the AFTER crate are not premises and do not enter the decision

status_assignment.UNCHANGED: member path present in AFTER with identical normalized entry (bytes, sha256, kind, executable)
status_assignment.CONTRADICTED: member path present in AFTER with a differing normalized entry
status_assignment.UNKNOWN: member path absent from the AFTER crate
status_assignment.ENTAILED: never assigned by extractor v1; no mechanical entailment receipt exists in the frozen substrate

candidate_policy_identity.revoke_spelling: the transport law's REVOKE is spelled REOPEN per the A3 terminal alphabet in EXECUTION_AND_ANALYSIS_FREEZE_V1.json

candidate_visible_record_contract.normalization_source: bind_workflowhub_rocrate_content_v1.py normalized_content_manifest, frozen v2 preflight, applied verbatim

independence: the candidate is not one of the five non-candidate baselines in baselines_v1.py and shares no code path with them; the analyzer's strongest_noncandidate_baseline_id can never resolve to A3_TRANSPORT_THREE_VALUED_V1
prediction_sequencing: candidate predictions are computed only after the EligibleChangeClusterPool is allocated (strata already externally adjudicated); gold stays escrowed with the external curator until every candidate and baseline prediction is sealed
